ls_timesheet.label: Timecard Approval (LS_TIMESHEET)
ls_timesheet.description: Paycom timecard approvals (Supervisor-type only) -- source for the Timecard Approval measure. Landing table refreshed via existing SP passthrough. Filtered to the last 120 days by DATE_APPROVED.
ls_timesheet.where_sql: APRROVAL_TYPE = 'Supervisor' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DATE_APPROVED >= '{today_minus_120}'

gracehill_location_compliance.label: Training Compliance (GraceHill)
gracehill_location_compliance.description: GraceHill Location Compliance -- source for the Training measure. Replaced by Peak Academy/Learn365 ETA 9/30/2026. Filtered to the last 200 days by DATE_KEY (YYYYMMDD int).

ls_training.label: Training (legacy LS_TRAINING)
ls_training.description: Legacy shape; not currently read by the live TR measure. Kept in the registry for auditability while the GraceHill/Peak Academy transition finalizes.

ls_prepaid_visa.label: PPV / P-Card (LS_PREPAID_VISA)
ls_prepaid_visa.description: Prepaid Visa reconciliation transactions -- source for the PCARD measure (any transaction in the quarter fails; zero = pass by default). Filtered to the last 120 days by DATETIME_RECONCILIATION.
ls_prepaid_visa.where_sql: PROPERTY_KEY IS NOT NULL AND DATETIME_RECONCILIATION >= '{today_minus_120}'

ls_compliance_import.label: Compliance Import (LS_COMPLIANCE_IMPORT)
ls_compliance_import.description: Risk Assessment action-item import (Leonardo 24/7). Currently drives the Risk Assessment measure only; IIPP/LFA/LEO derivations moved to LEO_COMPLIANCE_EXPORT_FACT after 2026-09-22 stakeholder correction.

leo_compliance_export.label: LEO Compliance Export
leo_compliance_export.description: LEO Compliance Export -- IIPP_COMPLETE / LEASE_FILE_AUDIT_COMPLETE / BONUS_PM_SCORE / BONUS_MS_SCORE. Any monthly snapshot showing 0 in the quarter fails the whole quarter (min-aggregation).

reputation_com_summary.label: Reputation.com Summary
reputation_com_summary.description: Reputation.com summary snapshots -- source for the Reputation measure (closing-Friday-of-quarter comparison, >1% improvement to pass). BirdEye replacement ETA 9/30/2026. Full table is ~17M rows; filtered to the last 200 days.
reputation_com_summary.where_sql: DATERANGETO >= '{today_minus_200}' AND SCORE IS NOT NULL

work_order_requests.label: Work Orders
work_order_requests.description: Work order completion detail -- source for both the PM (WO) and Maintenance (MSWO) measures. Genuinely system-fed via WH_ODS/Entrata, no manual step. Full table is ~1.7M rows; filtered to completed work orders in the last 120 days.
work_order_requests.where_sql: STATUS IN ('Complete', 'COMPLETED') AND COMPLETED_DATE >= '{today_minus_120}' AND NET_OPEN_DAY_COUNT IS NOT NULL

rm_quarterly_inspection_scores.label: RM Quarterly Inspection Scores
rm_quarterly_inspection_scores.description: RM Quarterly Inspection scores (Curb Appeal / Public Areas / Maintenance / Logs & Binders). 85-point pass threshold per section.

income_statement_by_gl.label: Income Statement (GL)
income_statement_by_gl.description: GL-level income statement -- source for NOI actual/budget context. Actual pass/fail is manually entered per stakeholder confirmation (2026-09-22). Full table is ~1M rows across years; filtered to the most recent PERIOD (YYYYMM int), TOP 3000 covers the first several GL codes across all properties.

lease_agg.label: Fall Forecast Actuals (LEASE_AGG)
lease_agg.description: Daily historical snapshots of Complete/New/Renewal Fall lease counts per property x AY x floorplan. Feeds the Fall Forecast tab and Bonus Calc Form export. Filtered to the current preleasing AY (from ACADEMIC_YEARS.FLAG_AY_PRELEASE_AY) up through today; TOP 3000 covers the latest ~7 days across all properties.

targets_by_day.label: Fall Forecast Targets
targets_by_day.description: Weekly leasing TARGETS per property x AY (Complete/New/Renewal). Not observed data -- these are the pre-loaded goal values the pipeline compares actuals against. Filtered to the current preleasing AY (from ACADEMIC_YEARS.FLAG_AY_PRELEASE_AY) up through today; TOP 3000 covers the latest ~7 days across all properties.

scorecard_core.label: SCORECARD_CORE (main output)
scorecard_core.description: Single-row-per-property-per-quarter output of the pipeline. Every measure column + its <MEASURE>_LOCKED bit + RULES_APPLIED_JSON audit stamp. Powered by NB_SCORECARD_PIPELINE.

scorecard_core_staging.label: SCORECARD_CORE_STAGING
scorecard_core_staging.description: Pre-merge staging of the latest pipeline run's assembled rows. Truncated + reloaded on every PROCESSING_WRITE_STAGING execution.

scorecard_pipeline_control.label: Pipeline Control (steps enabled/disabled)
scorecard_pipeline_control.description: Row per pipeline step (STEP_NAME, STEP_GROUP, STEP_ORDER, ENABLED, ABORT_ON_FAILURE). Toggling ENABLED flips a step on/off for the next scheduled run without a code change.

scorecard_pipeline_run_log.label: Pipeline Run Log
scorecard_pipeline_run_log.description: One row per (step x run). Read by EXPORT_SUMMARY to emit the run summary and by admins investigating a failed scheduled run.

scorecard_measure_rules.label: Measure Rules (thresholds)
scorecard_measure_rules.description: Effective-dated rule rows per measure (RULE_TYPE + SOURCE_FIELD + PARAM_NUM, EFFECTIVE_FROM/TO). Changing a threshold is a data edit here + a pipeline re-run, no code change. Stamped onto each SCORECARD_CORE row via RULES_APPLIED_JSON for bonus-payout auditability.
